description: Erection of ground floor single storey wrap around rear extension incorporating alterations including rooflights, windows replacement and relocation of side window and door.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: Unnumbered Location Plan, Planning, Heritage, Design & Access Statement, Fire Safety Statement and Flood Risk Assessment. Received: 22/11/2023
